name: Harden
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 1, druid 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Area one object or a 10-foot cube of matter
Duration 1 hour/level (D)
Saving Throw Fortitude negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

You increase an object’s hardness by 50 percent or by +1, whichever is greater.
